preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= arr[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array arr must be between 0 and 100,000.
There must be at least one node with arr[i] = -1, indicating the root of the tree.

postconditions.description: The output must be the height of the binary tree as a string.
The height of the binary tree must be a non-negative integer.
The height of the binary tree must not exceed the number of nodes N.
